operator_observation: 目前来看实际运动路径根本不可能出现按安全问题
finding: The physical arm occupies the measured pose without the contacts reported by the capsule union. The discrepancy is too large to explain as the configured 3 mm clearance alone; capsule decomposition, frame placement, sweep inflation and ignore-pair generation must be re-audited against physical poses.
decision: Withdraw the prior demo confirmation for CAL-033 and CAL-034. CAL-035 and CAL-036 remain numeric policies but no longer provide a valid path-safety conclusion with the current capsules. Keep the profile geometry unchanged until a replacement model is fitted; do not silently broaden global ignore pairs.
temporary_operation_policy: A collision override may be used only for a named recovery route explicitly confirmed clear by the on-site operator. Joint limits, command step, joint/TCP speed and acceleration, feedback, current and communication checks remain enabled. This is not a general collision bypass.
